items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: The interviewee never mentions Dick McDonough in the provided transcript. The name 'Dick' appears only as a form of address to the interviewer (e.g., 'I wouldn't know, Dick', 'you might know of, Dick').

ctx.x: What's his name anyway? Full name, do you remember? Ramis?

Uh huh. I wouldn't know, Dick, I wouldn't know he's, he's, he's full. That's the only thing I can remember. Tony could tell, could tell you all about it. Oh yeah. Because he worked with Tony for, for a number of years at that, the Vita.
Oh, by the way, what about Rag Baby Steelers? Who did he play with mostly?
